name: Gravity
author: mahziyarng98
description: An orbital launcher that surfaces the apps you actually use, ranked by launches in a rolling three-day window, with suggestions filling any slot real usage has not claimed yet

barWidget.description: An orbital launcher that surfaces the apps you actually use, ranked by launches in a rolling three-day window, with suggestions filling any slot real usage has not claimed yet

schema.label: Pinned apps
schema.description: Comma-separated window classes that always hold a slot, in orbit order, e.g. "v2rayn, org.gnome.Nautilus". Pins outrank both launch counts and suggestions. Run `hyprctl clients -j | grep class` to read a window's class.

schema.label: Ignored apps
schema.description: Comma-separated window classes that never earn a slot -- not by launches, not as a cold-start suggestion. Matched on the window class: an app's StartupWMClass when its .desktop entry declares one, otherwise its desktop id.

schema.label: Apps in orbit
schema.description: How many icons sit on the ring. Six is the maximum the circle holds; any slot not filled by a pin or by recent usage gets a suggestion.

schema.label: Seconds per revolution
schema.description: How long the orbit takes to come back around. Rotation pauses whenever an icon is hovered or keyboard-selected.
